results.title: Bigg Boss 20: Scout OP's Girlfriend Kaashvi Reacts To His 'Connection' With Love Gill
results.description: Bigg Boss 20 has once again found itself at the centre of online discussion, this time after ScoutOP opened up about his growing attachment to fellow contestant Love Gill during a conversation with YUNG DSA. While Scout continued to describe his equation with Love as sibling-like, his admission that he has started feeling possessive around her left viewers questioning whether his emotions inside the house are becoming more complicated. © Jio HotstarScout OP's Girlfriend Reacts To His Feelings For Love GillThe conversation also caught the attention of Scout’s girlfriend, Kashvi Hiranandani. The YouTuber, who is in a relationship with Scout outside the Bigg Boss house, was reportedly watching the episode during a livestream when the discussion took place.As Scout spoke about his bond with Love, Kashvi appeared visibly upset, prompting viewers to closely watch her reaction. She did not directly address the conversation, but her expressions became a talking point in the livestream comments, with several viewers speculating about what she may have been thinking.One user commented, "I am curious to see what she does next I will only feel bad for her if she dumps him after seeing all these."Another user commented, " I don't like kashvi....but it's really wrong she doesn't deserve itt...Hope she dumps this cheater soon...."During his conversation with YUNG, Scout admitted that he sometimes feels possessive when he sees Love spending time with Gullu. He also acknowledged that the unusual circumstances inside the Bigg Boss house can intensify relationships, particularly when contestants spend almost all their time together and are separated from their lives outside.Despite admitting to these feelings, Scout insisted that he sees Love in a sibling-like way. When YUNG asked him directly about the nature of their relationship, Scout agreed that he viewed her as a sister.At one point, Scout said, "Sister se pehle aadmi friend hota hai na (Before being a sister, a person is a friend.)" YUNG then pushed him further and asked, “Kya tera raasta badal raha hai? (Is your path changing?)"Scout's response was brief: "Pata nahi (Don't know.)" © Jio HotstarThe exchange appeared to capture Scout's own uncertainty about how he should interpret his growing closeness with Love. At the same time, he made it clear that there is someone special waiting for him outside the reality show. Although he did not openly name Kashvi, he appeared to refer to the first letter of her name.Given that Scout and Kashvi's relationship is already known to Bigg Boss viewers, his comments about Love have naturally sparked curiosity among fans following his journey.Interestingly, YUNG also opened up about his own relationship during the conversation. He spoke about missing his girlfriend while staying inside the house and admitted that the emotional strain of being separated from her had become difficult to handle. At one point, he said he had almost "lost himself" while dealing with everything.

results.title: ‘They have hijacked nation through vote chori’: Rahul Gandhi’s fierce attack on BJP, RSS, CEC
results.description: Amid the INDIA bloc’s protest against the Election Commission, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi alleged that around 300 Opposition MPs wanted to meet CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the two Election Commissioners but were stopped by police. Questioning why elected representatives were not allowed to reach the ECI office, Gandhi accused the poll panel of undermining democracy. He also alleged that the BJP-led leadership had “hijacked” the country through “vote chori” and claimed that Gyanesh Kumar had helped them. These are Rahul Gandhi’s allegations made during the protest.

results.title: How Meta and Microsoft’s ‘Claude message’ to employees show Anthropic has a ‘complicated problem’
results.description: Microsoft and Meta are taking steps to limit their internal usage of Anthropic’s Claude models for cost management. Microsoft has reduced its spending projections on Anthropic tools, impacting its developers by lowering budget ceilings. Meta has also seen a decline in usage of Claude Code alongside the introduction of its internal alternatives. Both companies are encouraging engineers to use their proprietary AI tools instead of external ones.
